name: Icon Color Test
description: Dynamically adapts your icon colors to the level's Background (BG) and Ground (G) colors.

enable-mod.name: Enable Mod
enable-mod.description: Enables or disables the entire mod.

color-1-copy.name: Color 1 Copy
color-1-copy.description: Selects which level color channel to copy for Primary Color (Color 1).

color-2-copy.name: Color 2 Copy
color-2-copy.description: Selects which level color channel to copy for Secondary Color (Color 2).

glow-copy.name: Glow Copy
glow-copy.description: Selects which level color channel to copy for Glow (only applies if Glow is enabled).

combine-color.name: Combine Color
combine-color.description: Blends copied level colors with your original garage colors (ignored for channels set to None).

invert-color.name: Invert Color
invert-color.description: Inverts the final RGB colors of all player icons (including channels set to None).
